g.text: EEPROM Write Protect Open (default, HIGH): read allowed, write prohibited Closed (LOW): read & write allowed
*All hardare config pins default low with internal pull down resistors See datasheet page 16 for all available options.
Cut each jumper to disable each LED
*place C15 (0.1uF) close to DVDD *place C11 (0.68uF) close to DLDO
VDD Ranges 3.13V - 3.46V [2.4V p-p or 1.0V p-p transmit level] 1.71V - 3.46V [1.0V p-p transmit level]
Based on a MM Ethernet board by N. Seidle
Connector Shield Grounding options Set jumper to select either: (1) direct connection to GND or (2) [default] through a cap to GND.
